item.title: Where the Crawdads Sing
item.description:
Where the Crawdads Sing by Delia Owens

Summary

“Where the Crawdads Sing” is a novel that intertwines two timelines and follows the life of Kya Clark, the “Marsh Girl” living in the coastal swamps of North Carolina. Abandoned by her family at a young age, Kya grows up isolated and learns to survive on her own, deeply connected to the natural world around her. The narrative explores themes of loneliness, survival, and the resilience of the human spirit.
